other.tags: Ambient post-rock with shoegaze influences. The track features a clean, delay-heavy electric guitar playing a repetitive, arpeggiated melody. A deep, sustained synth bass provides a low-end drone. Percussion consists of a steady, mid-tempo kick drum and a crisp snare with significant reverb. Atmospheric synth pads swell in the background, creating a dense sonic wash. The arrangement builds layers of distorted guitar textures and shimmering high-end frequencies. Tempo is 100 BPM in 4/4 time.
other.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[clean electric guitar with delay, arpeggiated melody]
[soft synth pad swells]

[Section A]
[steady kick drum enters]
[sustained synth bass drone]
[reverberant snare on beats 2 and 4]

[Section B]
[distorted guitar layers enter]
[increased density of synth pads]
[shimmering high-frequency textures]

[Outro]
[drums drop out]
[fading guitar delay and synth drone]

bass.tags: Industrial rock and dark synthwave fusion. The track features a distorted, overdriven bass guitar playing a repetitive, syncopated eighth-note riff. A heavy, acoustic drum kit provides a slow, pounding beat with a gated reverb on the snare and a deep, resonant kick. Layered over the rhythm section are dissonant, screeching industrial synth textures and occasional metallic percussion hits. A clean, palm-muted electric guitar enters later, playing a rhythmic ostinato. The tempo is 85 BPM in the key of D minor. The production is dense and gritty, with significant compression on the master bus and a dark, cavernous reverb applied to the percussion.
bass.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[distorted synth drone, low-frequency hum]
[heavy kick drum enters, slow tempo]

[Section A]
[overdriven bass guitar riff, syncopated eighth notes]
[gated snare drum enters on beats 2 and 4]
[metallic percussion accents]

[Section B]
[dissonant synth lead enters, high-pitched screeching texture]
[palm-muted electric guitar ostinato]
[crash cymbal hits at phrase transitions]

[Outro]
[drums and guitar drop out]
[fading distorted bass and synth drone]

drums.tags: Hard rock drum track. The kit consists of a punchy kick drum, a crisp snare with a medium-length tail, hi-hats, and crash cymbals. The performance begins with a steady 4/4 backbeat featuring eighth-note hi-hat patterns. The kick drum follows a syncopated pattern, often hitting on the 1, the 'and' of 2, and the 3. Frequent snare fills utilize sixteenth-note triplets and rapid rolls across the kit. The intensity increases with the introduction of open hi-hat accents and more frequent crash cymbal hits on the downbeats. The tempo is 120 BPM in 4/4 time.
drums.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[four-beat hi-hat count-in]
[steady 4/4 rock beat enters, closed hi-hats, snare on 2 and 4]

[Section A]
[syncopated kick drum pattern]
[occasional open hi-hat accents]

[Section B]
[increased velocity on snare]
[crash cymbal hits on beat 1 of every four bars]
[sixteenth-note snare fill]

[Section C]
[ride cymbal replaces hi-hats]
[double-time kick drum accents]
[rapid tom-tom fill]

[Outro]
[final crash cymbal swell]
[reverb tail fades]

vocals.tags: Industrial techno with heavy EBM influences. A distorted, saturated kick drum drives the rhythm at 130 BPM in 4/4 time. A resonant, metallic synth sequence with a short decay provides a percussive melodic hook. A low-frequency sawtooth bassline follows the kick with a slight swing. High-frequency white noise bursts and filtered hi-hats create rhythmic tension. A dark, atmospheric pad with a slow attack and long release sits in the background. The track features a breakdown with a high-pass filter sweep on the main kick and synth sequence, followed by a sudden re-entry of the full low-end. Distorted, processed vocal samples are used as rhythmic elements rather than melodic leads.
vocals.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[distorted kick drum, metallic synth sequence]
[filtered hi-hats enter]

[Main Section]
[sawtooth bassline, saturated kick]
[white noise bursts, rhythmic vocal samples]

[Breakdown]
[high-pass filter sweep on kick and synths]
[atmospheric pad swells]

[Drop]
[full low-end re-entry, driving industrial percussion]
[resonant synth hook]
